$comment: Three projects over one local pair, so the handoff can be forced and measured:
pair         admits local/*; the router chooses per turn
run_pair.py replays one conversation under source-only, then re-sends the same
history under target-only. The target's first turn is the cold prefill a mapped
cache would skip. Model names below must match serve_pair.sh and env.sh.
Secrets are never in this file: run mint_keys.py to fill key_sha256 and write
